component.name: Nutstore
坚果云
component.summary: File sync, sharing and backup client for the Nutstore cloud drive
坚果云文件同步、共享与备份客户端

developer.name: Shanghai YiJing Network Tech Co., Ltd

description.p: This is a community package of Nutstore, maintained independently. It repackages the official upstream Linux build unmodified.
Nutstore (坚果云) keeps folders in sync between your computers and the Nutstore cloud, shares them with others, and keeps file history as a backup.

This package can read and write your home folder: Nutstore syncs any folder you choose there, and keeps its account data in ~/.nutstore, which a native Nutstore install on the same computer also uses.
The tray menu works, but the tray icon may show as a generic icon: the client points it at an image inside the sandbox, which the desktop's tray cannot read.
Updates come through Flatpak. When the client downloads a newer version itself, that version only runs until the client exits.
